nodes.description: A personal knowledge management tool/system designed to organize, search, and process information intelligently.
The core system for structuring and maintaining a knowledge repository, configured via `.llmwikidoc.toml`.
The specific LLM model configured to be used by the `llmwikidoc` system.
The root directory where the knowledge base information is organized, including concepts, entities, and summaries.
A feature within `llmwikidoc` that manages the reliability score of information with mechanisms for reinforcement, contradiction penalties, and decay over time.
An advanced search mechanism combining lexical (BM25), semantic (Vectors), and graph-based approaches for information retrieval.
An AI assistant (claude.ai/code) provided with specific working rules for interacting with this project repository.
The planned functionality for bringing knowledge into the system from various sources like folders, S3, async REST APIs, Kafka, and RabbitMQ.
The planned user interface for the 'Knowledge Management Center', to be built using Vue and Pinia.
A planned NodeJS component acting as an API Rest and Websocket server, bridging the web interface and Python APIs, integrated with Keycloak for security.
Planned backend services developed with Python 1.13+, using uv, FastAPI, and FastMCP, exposing functionalities to the BFF.
An external identity and access management solution planned for security integration with the BFF.
A lexical search algorithm used as a component of the Hybrid Search System.
A semantic search method based on vector embeddings, used as a component of the Hybrid Search System.
A search method based on relationships and graphs, used as a component of the Hybrid Search System.
